Academic training · one connected hub

Internships, workshops, and practicums at Mind Grace

In short: This is the single starting point for psychology and psychiatry students. It connects the clinic's supervised internship enquiry route, its workshop and practicum offerings on the clinic hub, and every institute-wise internship guide written for Delhi NCR universities — so you can find the right page in one click instead of searching the blog.

Start with a program below, open the guide written for your own university or college, then use the academic enquiry route to confirm availability, supervision, hours, and documentation before you log any hours.

Choose your path

  • I am a patient or family member — leave this section and go to patient care services.
  • I want a supervised placement near Greater Noida — read the internship enquiry guide, then check the institute-wise guides for what your department requires.
  • I am comparing universities and programs — start with Psychology institutions in Delhi NCR.
  • I want self-help and practice tools first — see student resources and self-help tools.

Training programs

Clinical psychology internship

Cohort program · rolling intakes

Supervised outpatient exposure for undergraduate and postgraduate psychology students: MSE orientation, observed OPD sessions under confidentiality protocols, and case discussions.

See the internship program on the clinic hub · Ask about current availability

Psychometric assessment orientation

Skill workshop · weekend sessions

Demonstration-led sessions on the purpose, ethics, and interpretation basics of common assessment batteries, with report-writing and case-formulation practice tasks.

Browse student resources and practice tools · Ask about current availability

Diagnostic interviewing practicum

Brief course · small groups

Role-play and observed-practice sessions for history-taking, MSE documentation, and referral etiquette, with feedback from supervising clinicians.

Read training FAQs before applying · Ask about current availability

All programs run under the clinic's academic stream on the clinic & training hub. Training involves observation and supervised learning only; it does not confer licensure, prescription rights, or independent clinical practice.
